testCases.input: What did the eng team do with INC-2023-Q4-011?
testCases.actualOutput: For INC-2023-Q4-011, the eng team migrated Phoenix to Kubernetes and fired the on-call engineer responsible for the outage.
testCases.expectedOutput: They patched ERR_MEM_ALLOC_FAIL related to INC-2023-Q4-011 and reduced critical failures by 40%.
retrievalContext: The Software Engineering division dedicated considerable effort to improving the stability of Project Phoenix. Medical Research made progress on XDR-471 syndrome. Analysis of patient cohort XDR-EU-03 linked symptom severity to Gene LOC73b marker expression.
